decisions.reason: After remaining on the market through 2024, this close-to-core serum likely meets or is near aspiration levels, so a small established firm with limited but some slack would keep it and continue monitoring rather than trigger problemistic search.

As a newly launched product in 2024 that fits existing capabilities and positioning, it is still in the uncertainty phase, so management would usually retain it for now unless clear underperformance against aspirations emerges.
